decisions.label: Figure 1
decisions.caption: Overview of SelfWAM. Compared with action-unconditioned video prediction, SelfWAM shifts the model from a passive observer to an actor that predicts the visual consequences of its own actions, making future generation both action-sensitive and action-consistent.
decisions.reason: 作为全景概览图，直观对比了动作无条件化视频预测与动作条件化/自掩膜预测的核心差异，并在右侧展示了部署期快速闭环推理路径，最适合放在方法主线的机制流程小节。

decisions.caption: SelfWAM architecture and attention design. Left: the modality-specialized MoT contains a video backbone and a lightweight action expert coupled through mixed attention. decisions.reason: 详尽展示了 MoT 架构、训练期非对称注意力拓扑矩阵以及双推理模式，是理解非对称信息流和防止标签泄漏的核心架构图，适合放在 Self-Grounded Formulation 和 MoT 小节。
